payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB) loads with split sizes (train 89996 / val 10004 / test 7180) exactly matching the official MedMNIST distribution; no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA-256 are present and the verified MD5 matches the manifest. All nine tissue-type labels are accounted for. The test-domain note correctly flags that CRC-VAL-HE-7K test images originate from a different clinical center, which is the intended OOD evaluation design and is properly documented. Run manifest records seed 42, deterministic_torch=true, and full package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, medmnist 3.0.2, lightning 2.6.5, numpy 2.4.6, Python 3.11.15). No deterministic findings were raised. One minor traceability note: llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, which means the exact model weights cannot be pinned for reproducibility; this is a warning-level observation, not a blocker. No omitted artefacts. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama); exact model weights are not pinned for full reproducibility – recommend recording a digest or commit hash in a future run.
